{{Card |title=Arcona |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Alien]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Arcona-PSA-164793233.jpg |lead='''Arcona''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_1o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |power=1 |ability=1 |deploy=2 |forfeit=2 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Arcona]] (2_1)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Arcona (Revised)]] (52_1)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_1o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊＊＊アルコーナ |printed_game_text=“夜間状態”では戦闘力＋1。その位置カード上で起こった戦闘から“リアクション”として移動して逃げることができる。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Arcona-PSA-164793233.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ウナット・ポルは典型的なアルコーナの男性だ。この種族には珍しく、彼は塩分の摂取を避けてきた。同盟軍に荷担していることで知られる偵察兵。'' |translation='''Title:''' Arcona. '''Card text:''' Power +1 under "nighttime conditions." May move away from a battle that occurred at that location card as a "react." '''Lore:''' Unut Poll is a typical male Arcona. Unusually for this species, he has avoided salt. A scout known to cooperate with the Alliance. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Arcona]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

{{Card |title=Brainiac |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Alien]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Brainiac-PSA-156625019.jpg |lead='''Brainiac''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_2o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=π |power=* |ability=3 |deploy=Y |forfeit=X |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Brainiac]] (2_2)
'''Decipher (Revised)''' — [[Brainiac (Revised)]] (52_2)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_2o)
'''Decipher (Japanese Reflections II foil)''' — [[Brainiac (Japanese Reflections II Foil)]]
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Brainiac (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)]] (1115_8)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Brainiac (V)]] (1210_90) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊ブレイニアック |printed_game_text=＊戦闘力＝√3（X－Y）＋2（A－B）＋π（最低でも戦闘力＝1）。X＝ダークサイドの手札の枚数、Y＝ライトサイドの手札の枚数、A＝場に出ているカードのダークアイコンの合計数、B＝場に出ているカードのライトアイコンの合計数、π＝3.141592653589793238462643383...である。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Brainiac-PSA-156625019.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ボシェックはこのシニティーンの男性に“ブレイニアック（頭でっかち）”というあだ名をつけた。その名にふさわしく、彼はハイパースペースの座標を自分の頭で計算できる。レイアの脱獄作戦も、彼が立案していたらさぞかし・・・'' |translation='''Title:''' Brainiac. '''Card text:''' *Power = √3(X-Y)+2(A-B)+π (minimum power = 1). X = Dark Side cards in hand. Y = Light Side cards in hand. A = total Dark icons in play. B = total Light icons in play. π = 3.141592653589793238462643383... '''Lore:''' BoShek nicknamed this male Siniteen "Brainiac" (big-headed). True to the name, he can calculate hyperspace coordinates in his head. If he had planned Leia's jailbreak, surely... '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore wonders what if he had planned Leia's jailbreak; the English quotes BoShek. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Brainiac]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

{{Card |title=2-1B (Too-Onebee) |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Droid]]) |label_type=Card type |set=Hoth (Japanese) |language=ja |language_display=Japanese |label_language=Printed language |lead='''2-1B (Too-Onebee)''' is the Japanese-language printing of [[2-1B (Too-Onebee)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |gemp_id=1303_1o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |rarity=Rare1 |rarity_display=Rare1 |edition=[[Hoth (Japanese)]] |border_finish=Black border / nonfoil |release=September 1998 |versions='''Decipher''' — [[2-1B (Too-Onebee)]] (3_1o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this page''' (1303_1o), [[Hoth (Japanese)]], September 1998
'''PC Errata''' — [[2-1B (Too-Onebee) (PC Errata)]] (3_1)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)]] (1104_1)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V)]] (1220_86) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊2-1B（トゥ・ワンビー） |printed_game_text=1ターンに1回、同じ位置か隣接した位置でロストしたドロイド以外のキャラクターを1名、ロストデッキの代わりにユーズドデッキに移せる。バクタ・タンクのXの値から2を引ける（累積可能）。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-2-1B-PSA-175224368.jpg|Original Japanese Hoth printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ジーンテック社製。ドロイドとしては非常に強い自我を持つ。いやいや仕えていたフィアロ駐留のモフから、タイリーが逃がしてくれた。以来、同盟軍で働いている。'' |translation='''Title:''' 2-1B (Too-Onebee). '''Card text:''' Once per turn, one non-droid character lost at the same or an adjacent location may be moved to the Used Deck instead of the Lost Deck. May subtract 2 from Bacta Tank's X value (cumulative). '''Lore:''' Manufactured by Geentech. Has a very strong sense of self for a droid. Tiree helped him escape from the Moff stationed on Firro, whom he had served unwillingly. He has worked for the Alliance ever since. |see_also=* [[2-1B (Too-Onebee)|English counterpart]] * [[Hoth (Japanese)#Card list|Japanese Hoth card list]] * [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese|Japanese printings]] |see_also_heading=See also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-2-1B-PSA-175224368.jpg |destiny=1 |power=0 |deploy=2 |forfeit=5 |uniqueness=Unique |extra_info=Printed subtype医療用ドロイド Subtype[[Droid]] }}

{{Card |title=Artillery Remote |side=Light |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Artillery-Remote-PSA-156433114.jpg |lead='''Artillery Remote''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_28o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Artillery Remote]] (3_28o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_28o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Artillery Remote (PC Errata)]] (3_28)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Artillery Remote (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)]] (1115_3)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Artillery Remote (V)]] (1220_108) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=固定兵器用リモート |printed_game_text=２フォース消費して任意の戦士に配備する。同じ惑星上にある自分の固定兵器はいずれも、兵器がある場所に戦士がいなくても起動できる。加えて毎ターン１回、自分の起動フェイズに同じ惑星上の固定兵器を１つ起動することができる。フォースは通常どおりに消費する。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Artillery-Remote-PSA-156433114.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''固定兵器には手動の発射機構がついているが、この装置を追加することによって、離れた場所から操作できるようになる。制御用の信号は暗号化されている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Artillery remote. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any warrior. Any of your artillery weapons on the same planet may fire even if no warrior is present at the weapon's location. Also, once per turn during your control phase, you may fire one artillery weapon on the same planet. Force is spent as usual. '''Lore:''' Artillery weapons have a manual firing mechanism, but adding this device lets them be operated from a remote location. The control signals are encrypted. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Artillery Remote]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Atgar Laser Cannon |side=Light |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Atgar-Laser-Cannon-PSA-152940011.jpg |lead='''Atgar Laser Cannon''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_72o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |deploy=2 |forfeit=2 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Atgar Laser Cannon]] (3_72o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_72o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Atgar Laser Cannon (Errata)]] (3_72) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=アトガー・レーザー砲 |printed_game_text=屋外の惑星位置上に配備する。移動不可。同じ場所にいる自分の戦士が、２フォース消費して同じか隣接する位置にいる目標に対して起動できる。運命数を引く。運命数＋２＞装甲値ならビークルはクラッシュする。運命数＋１＞回避値ならビークルは命中を受ける。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Atgar-Laser-Cannon-PSA-152940011.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''アトガー1.4FD Pタワー、対ビークル砲。改造により、極寒低温の環境でも機能がほとんど低下しない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Atgar laser cannon. '''Card text:''' Deploy on an exterior planet site. Cannot be moved. Your warrior at the same location may fire at a target at the same or an adjacent location, using 2 Force. Draw destiny. A vehicle crashes if destiny +2 > armor. A vehicle is hit if destiny +1 > maneuver. '''Lore:''' Atgar 1.4 FD P-tower, an anti-vehicle cannon. After modification, its performance hardly falls even in extreme cold. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Atgar Laser Cannon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Attack Pattern Delta |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Attack-Pattern-Delta-PSA-156433120.jpg |lead='''Attack Pattern Delta''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_40o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Attack Pattern Delta]] (3_40)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_40o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Attack Pattern Delta (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)]] (1104_2)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Attack Pattern Delta (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (1220_137)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Attack Pattern Delta (V)]] (222_19) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=アタックパターン・デルタ |printed_game_text=位置カードで戦闘が宣言された直後に使用する。そこにいるＴ－４７を一機、先頭機として選ぶ。そのターンの終わりまで、同じ位置にいる他のＴ－４７はそれぞれ戦闘力＋１、加えて耐：損耗を得、武器の目標とならない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Attack-Pattern-Delta-PSA-156433120.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''スカイウォーカー中佐と反乱軍の戦術参謀ベリル・シフォナージが考案したスノースピーダー用の攻撃隊形。１列に並び、敵の砲火を先頭機が引き受けて後続機を守る。'' |translation='''Title:''' Attack Pattern Delta. '''Card text:''' Use immediately after a battle is declared at a location. Choose one T-47 there as the lead. Until the end of that turn, each other T-47 at the same location is power +1, immune to attrition, and may not be targeted by weapons. '''Lore:''' A snowspeeder attack formation devised by Commander Skywalker and Rebel tactician Beryl Chiffonage. They line up in single file, and the lead ship draws enemy fire to protect those behind. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese chooses one T-47 there as the lead; the English identifies your lead T-47. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Attack Pattern Delta]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Cal Alder |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Cal-Alder-PSA-151452830.jpg |lead='''Cal Alder''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_2o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=2 |ability=1 |deploy=2 |forfeit=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Cal Alder]] (3_2)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_2o)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Cal Alder (V)]] (206_2) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=＊キャル・アルダー |printed_game_text=防衛線では戦闘力＋１。自分のビークルは、キャルと同じ位置に移動するのならフォースを消費せずに移動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Cal-Alder-PSA-151452830.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''キャソル・セクターのカルシェボル出身。熟練した偵察兵。ブレン・ダーリンとは数年来の仲。エコー基地の外部防衛線をパトロールする。'' |translation='''Title:''' Cal Alder. '''Card text:''' Power +1 at a defensive perimeter. Your vehicles may move without spending Force if they move to the same location as Cal. '''Lore:''' From Kai'Shebbol in the Kathol sector. A skilled scout. He has served with Bren Derlin for years. He patrols the outer defensive line of Echo Base. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese moves vehicles for free when they move to Cal's location; the English when they move toward the same site as Cal. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Cal Alder]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1303_154o)
'''Decipher Errata''' - [[Blizzard 1 (Errata)]] (3_154)

'''Virtual Legacy''' - [[Blizzard 1 (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (1220_80)
'''Virtual Modern''' - [[Blizzard 1 (V)]] (217_4) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ブリザード1 |printed_game_text=2名のパイロットと8名の乗客を搭乗させられる。対：損耗＜4。「AT-ATレーザー砲」を使用して「目標、メイン・ジェネレーター」を試みる際、合計値に1を加える。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Blizzard-1-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ヴィアーズ将軍のAT-AT。密閉型。高度な通信装置を内蔵。実験的な照準システムを搭載している。'' |translation='''Title:''' Blizzard 1 '''Card text:''' Can carry 2 pilots and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4. When using an AT-AT Laser Cannon to attempt Target The Main Generator, add 1 to the total. '''Lore:''' General Veers' AT-AT. Enclosed. Has advanced communications equipment built in. Equipped with an experimental targeting system. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names the weapon AT-ATレーザー砲 (“AT-AT Laser Cannon”), where the original English names [[AT-AT Cannon]]. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Blizzard 1]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Admiral Ozzel |side=Dark |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Admiral-Ozzel-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg |lead='''Admiral Ozzel''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_82o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=0 |power=3 |ability=2 |deploy=0 |forfeit=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' - [[Admiral Ozzel]] (3_82o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' - '''this printing''' (1303_82o)
'''Decipher Errata''' - [[Admiral Ozzel (Errata)]] (3_82)
'''Virtual Original''' - [[Admiral Ozzel (V) (Virtual Set 14: Armed & Operational)]] (1114_17) (slip 17)
'''Virtual Legacy''' - [[Admiral Ozzel (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (1220_1)
'''Virtual Modern''' - [[Admiral Ozzel (V)]] (213_1) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=オゼル提督 |printed_game_text=自分の大型艦は同じ星系に－1で配備できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。場にベイダーが出ており、相手がオゼルと同じロケーションにリアクションで移動してきたなら、オゼル提督は即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Admiral-Ozzel-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''反乱軍を発見し壊滅させるために皇帝が編成したデス・スコードロンのリーダー。愚鈍で不器用。ダース・ベイダーに失策を露呈したばかりで、もはや失敗は許されない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Admiral Ozzel '''Card text:''' Your capital starships may deploy at -1 to the same system. Adds 2 to the power of the starship he pilots. If Vader is on the table and the opponent moves to Ozzel's location as a react, Admiral Ozzel is immediately lost. '''Lore:''' Leader of the Death Squadron formed by the Emperor to find and destroy the Rebels. Stupid and clumsy. Having just exposed his failure to Darth Vader, he can afford no further failures. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore expresses the English “next-to-last time” joke as allowing no further failures. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Admiral Ozzel]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: At the end of a battle, if after forfeiting all cards deployed at that location damage still remains, cancel all remaining damage. On Kinyen, the Gran homeworld, it is often kept as a watchdog or pet. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_51o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=なんだか嫌な予感がする |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：このターンに相手が4人以上のキャラクターを同じ位置に配備した場合に使用する。それらのキャラクターは全員、このターンの間は戦闘を行えない。2：相手が戦闘に対して“リアクション”を行った直後に使用する。その戦闘をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-I-Have-A-Very-Bad-Feeling-About-This-PSA-173318901.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「あの小型機、小さな月に向かってるよ」「月ではない。あれは宇宙ステーションだ」オビ＝ワンの言葉を聞いてルークは胸騒ぎを覚えた。'' |translation='''Title:''' I have a somehow unpleasant premonition. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Use if the opponent deployed 4 or more characters to the same location this turn. Those characters may not battle for the rest of this turn. 2: Use immediately after the opponent “reacts” to a battle. Cancel that battle. '''Lore:''' “That small craft is heading for a small moon.” “That is not a moon. It is a space station.” Hearing Obi-Wan's words, Luke felt a pang of unease. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is なんだか嫌な予感がする. The Japanese numbers the two options. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[I Have A Very Bad Feeling About This]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_43o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside (PC Errata)]] (3_43) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=臭いのは外側だけじゃなかったのか |printed_game_text=自分の乗用生物を一匹犠牲にする（ロストする）。同じ位置にいるキャラクターを１人選ぶ。キャラクターはこのターンの間、「凍死」、「雪嵐」、「凍傷」、「砂岩嵐」の影響を受けない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-I-Thought-They-Smelled-Bad-On-The-Outside-PSA-157878138.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「我慢しろよ、ルーク。臭いかもしれんが……シェルターをたてるまで……この中ならあったまる」'' |translation='''Title:''' So it didn't smell bad only on the outside. '''Card text:''' Sacrifice (lose) one of your creature vehicles. Choose one character at the same location. That character is immune to Exposure, Ice Storm, Frostbite and Gravel Storm this turn. '''Lore:''' "Hang on, Luke. It may smell, but… until I get a shelter up… you'll stay warm in here." '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese immunizes one character and has no Ronto extra or Tzizvvt power option. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese Reflections II foil)''' — [[Imperial Walker (Japanese Reflections II Foil)]] |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=インペリアル・ウォーカー |printed_game_text=1名のパイロットと8名の乗客を搭乗させられる。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Imperial-Walker-PSA-82733547.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''4本足の密閉型戦闘用ビークル。巨体を揺るがせて迫り来るＡＴ－ＡＴ（全地形対応装甲トランスポート）は、完全武装の兵員をまるまる1個大隊、輸送することができる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Imperial Walker. The looming AT-AT (All Terrain Armored Transport) can carry an entire battalion of fully armed soldiers. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says battalion where the English lore says squadron. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Walker]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. {{Card |title=Hypo |side=Dark |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] ([[Item]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Hypo-PSA-97065196.jpg |lead='''Hypo''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] ([[Item]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_112o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Hypo]] (2_112o)

'''PC Errata''' — [[Hypo (PC Errata)]] (2_112) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ハイポ |printed_game_text=ＩＴ－Ｏに配備する。自分の支配フェイズに捕虜と同じ位置にあれば、どちらかの効果を選ぶ。1：敵に、敵の手札について1つだけ、“はい”か“いいえ”で答えられる質問をする。敵は正直に答えるか、回答を拒否して1フォースを失う。2：フォース消耗を＋1する。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Hypo-PSA-97065196.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''バーヴォ6のような自白剤には、尋問への抵抗力を弱める効果がある。巨大な注射針を相手に向ける心理的効果は抜群で、尋問の効率も上がる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Hypo. '''Card text:''' Deploy on IT-O. If at the same location as a captive during your control phase, choose one effect. Ask your opponent one yes-or-no question about their hand. They must answer truthfully or refuse and lose 1 Force. Alternatively, increase the Force drain by 1. '''Lore:''' Truth drugs such as Bavo Six weaken resistance to questioning. Pointing an enormous needle at the subject adds psychological pressure and makes the interrogation more effective. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The original English strip reads Device. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Hypo]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

'''PC Errata''' — [[Infantry Mine (Dark) (PC Errata)]] (3_160) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=対人地雷 |printed_game_text=自分の地雷敷設ドロイドの1体と同じ屋外の位置に配備する。キャラクターがその位置に配備されるか移動してきたなら“爆発”する。ただし、ビークルや宇宙戦闘機を使用して移動してきた場合には爆発しない。運命数を引く。運命数＋2＞能力値なら、キャラクターはロストする。対人地雷もロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Infantry-Mine-Dark-PSA-88099886.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''強力な爆発物を内蔵している。反乱軍のスパイや工作員たちの侵入を阻むため、戦術的に重要な拠点や高度の警備を要する施設の防衛線にしばしば配備される。'' |translation='''Title:''' Infantry Mine (Dark). '''Lore:''' It contains a powerful explosive. It is often deployed on the defensive line of tactically important bases or high-security facilities to block Rebel spies and saboteurs. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Same printed title 対人地雷 as the Light card, so no native-title redirect. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Infantry Mine (Dark)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Lucky Shot (V)]] (1274_21) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ラッキー・ショット |printed_game_text=戦闘用ビークルを目標として起動している場合に、武器運命数にXを加える。実際に武器運命数を引く前に使用すること。ユーズド：X＝1。ロスト：X＝3。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Lucky-Shot-PSA-91317477.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''AT－ATの装甲に歩兵用火器は通用しないが、ごく稀にブラスターの光弾が装甲板の隙間を貫くこともある。非常に分の悪い賭だが、反乱軍にとってはいつものことだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Lucky Shot. '''Card text:''' When activating a weapon targeting a combat vehicle, add X to the weapon destiny. Use this before the weapon destiny is drawn. Used: X equals 1. Lost: X equals 3. '''Lore:''' Infantry weapons cannot pierce AT-AT armor, but a blaster bolt rarely hits a gap in the plating. It is a very poor bet, but such odds are nothing new for the Rebellion. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 起動する for targeting and writes USED/LOST as ユーズド／ロスト. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Lucky Shot]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon |side=Light |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Medium-Repeating-Blaster-Cannon-PSA-80497042.jpg |lead='''Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_77o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=1 |deploy=3 |forfeit=1 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon]] (3_77o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_77o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon (Errata)]] (3_77-DE) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=中型連射ブラスター・キャノン |printed_game_text=任意の位置に配備する。1フォース余分に支払うことにより、2名の戦士で移動させることができる。同じ場所にいる自分の戦士が、2フォース消費して同じか隣接する位置にいる2名のキャラクターを目標として起動できる。運命数を2枚引く。運命数＞能力値の合計で、両方のキャラクターに命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Medium-Repeating-Blaster-Cannon-PSA-80497042.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''マーソン・マークII連射式ブラスター。様々な種類の動力源を使用できるため、補給物資に事欠く反乱軍にとっては使い勝手がよい。'' |translation='''Title:''' Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon. '''Card text:''' Deploy at any location. Two warriors may move it by paying 1 extra Force. Your warrior at the same place may spend 2 Force to fire at two characters at the same or adjacent location. Draw two destiny. Both characters are hit if destiny exceeds total ability. '''Lore:''' A Merr-Sonn Mark II repeating blaster. It can use many kinds of power sources, so it is convenient for Rebels who often lack supplies. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 固定兵器. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Medium Transport |side=Light |type=Starship |type_display=[[Starship]] ([[Capital]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Medium-Transport-PSA-92654383.jpg |lead='''Medium Transport''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] ([[Capital]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_65o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |power=1 |armor=3 |hyperspeed=4 |deploy=2 |forfeit=4 |icons=[[Pilot]] [[Nav Computer]] [[Scomp Link]] |label_icons=Icons |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Medium Transport]] (3_65)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_65o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Medium Transport (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm)]] (1111_10) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=中型輸送艇 |printed_game_text=1名のパイロットと4名の乗客、1つのビークルを乗せられる。配備と移動に関しては、宇宙戦闘機と同様に扱う。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Medium-Transport-PSA-92654383.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ギャロフリー・ヤーズ製の人員／貨物輸送艇。巨大な貨物庫は艤装次第で多数の兵員や弾薬、補給物資などを収容できる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Medium Transport. '''Card text:''' May carry 1 pilot, 4 passengers, and 1 vehicle. Treat deploy and move like a starfighter. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. '''Lore:''' A personnel and cargo transport built by Gallofree Yards. Its huge cargo bays can, depending on outfitting, hold many troops, munitions, and supplies. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 大型艦：輸送艇. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Medium Transport]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Portable Fusion Generator |side=Dark |type=Device |type_display=[[Device]] ([[Item]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Portable-Fusion-Generator-PSA-92654371.jpg |lead='''Portable Fusion Generator''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] ([[Item]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_96o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Portable Fusion Generator]] (3_96)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_96o)
'''Decipher''' — [[Portable Fusion Generator (Dagobah)]] (4_13) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=携帯用融合ジェネレーター |printed_game_text=任意の戦士に配備する。その戦士がブラスター・ライフルか固定兵器を起動する場合、武器運命数にそれぞれ1を加える。さらに、同じ場所にいるドロイド1体の戦闘力に1を加えることができる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Portable-Fusion-Generator-PSA-92654371.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''大型の強襲用兵器を使用する際には、兵員自身が動力源を持ち歩かなければならない。この装置は軽量かつ高性能で、戦闘時に必要とされる動力を十分に供給してくれる。'' |translation='''Title:''' Portable Fusion Generator. '''Card text:''' Deploy on any warrior. When that warrior activates a blaster rifle or artillery weapon, add 1 to each weapon destiny. Also, may add 1 to the power of one droid at the same place. '''Lore:''' When using large assault weapons, troops must carry their own power sources. This unit is light and high-performance, and supplies ample power for combat. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese prints アイテム where English prints Device. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Portable Fusion Generator]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Our First Catch Of The Day |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Our-First-Catch-Of-The-Day-PSA-88099880.jpg |lead='''Our First Catch Of The Day''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_131o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=6 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Our First Catch Of The Day]] (3_131)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_131o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=本日最初の獲物だ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：牽引ビームの運命数に2を加える。2：「最初の輸送艇が突破しました！」か「ハイパー・エスケープ」をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Our-First-Catch-Of-The-Day-PSA-88099880.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「艦長、反乱軍の宇宙船が我々の警戒区域に接近しつつあります」'' |translation='''Title:''' Our First Catch Of The Day. '''Card text:''' Choose one. Add 2 to a tractor beam destiny. Cancel The First Transport Is Away! or Hyper Escape. '''Lore:''' Captain, Rebel starships are approaching our alert sector. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text numbers two choices, says 牽引ビーム, and quotes Japanese titles for The First Transport Is Away! and Hyper Escape. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Our First Catch Of The Day]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Perimeter Scan |side=Light |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Perimeter-Scan-PSA-91317479.jpg |lead='''Perimeter Scan''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_48o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Perimeter Scan]] (3_48)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_48o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Perimeter Scan (V) (Virtual Set 13: Remote Outpost)]] (1113_10)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Perimeter Scan (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (1220_151)
'''Virtual Modern''' — [[Perimeter Scan (V)]] (201_14) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=防衛線のスキャン |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：1フォース消費してロケーションに裏向きに置かれているカードを1枚覗く。2：1フォース消費して相手の手札を覗く。ドロイドのスパイか、対人地雷を見つけたら、すべて相手のユーズドデッキに移すことができる。3：「プローブ・ドロイド遠隔通信」をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Perimeter-Scan-PSA-91317479.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「どうやら、帝国に居場所がバレたみたいだな」'' |translation='''Title:''' Perimeter Scan. '''Card text:''' Choose one. Spend 1 Force to peek at one face-down card at a location. Spend 1 Force to peek at opponent’s hand. If you find droid spies or anti-personnel mines, you may move them all to opponent’s Used Deck. Cancel Probe Telemetry. '''Lore:''' Looks like the Empire has found out the location. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text numbers three choices after どちらかを選ぶ, uses ロケーション, 覗く, 対人地雷, ユーズドデッキ, and names Probe Telemetry as プローブ・ドロイド遠隔通信. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Perimeter Scan]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Jawa Ion Gun |side=Light |type=Weapon |type_display=[[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Jawa-Ion-Gun-SWCA-67707.jpg |lead='''Jawa Ion Gun''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_78o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Jawa Ion Gun]] (2_78o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_78o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Jawa Ion Gun (Errata)]] (2_78) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ジャワのイオン化銃 |printed_game_text=1フォースを使用して任意のジャワに配備する。あるいは3フォースを使用して任意の戦士に配備する。1フォースを使用して起動する。運命数を引く。ドロイドは運命数＋1＞没収値なら即座に“盗まれる”。ドロイド以外のキャラクターは運命数＝能力値なら、その戦闘から除外される。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Jawa-Ion-Gun-SWCA-67707.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''廃品のパワー・セルとドロイド行動規制ボルト、イオン加速装置を寄せ集めて作った武器。イオン・エネルギーの奔流を撃ち出す。動けなくなるのはドロイドだけだが、その他の者も撃たれて良い気分はしない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Jawa Ion Gun. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any Jawa. Or use 3 Force to deploy on any warrior. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A droid is immediately stolen if destiny plus 1 exceeds forfeit. A non-droid character is excluded from that battle if destiny equals ability. '''Lore:''' A weapon cobbled together from scrap power cells, droid restraining bolts, and an ion accelerator. It fires a torrent of ion energy. Only droids are immobilized, but anyone else who is hit does not feel good either. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title is ジャワのイオン化銃. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Jawa Ion Gun]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

{{Card |title=Merc Sunlet |side=Light |type=Effect |type_display=[[Effect]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Merc-Sunlet-SWCA-67708.jpg |lead='''Merc Sunlet''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_36o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=4 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Merc Sunlet]] (2_36o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_36o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Merc Sunlet (Errata)]] (2_36)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Merc Sunlet (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution)]] (1103_15) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=マーク・サンレット |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：盗賊以外のキャラクターに配備して盗賊の能力を与える。自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置カード上にあるアイテムを1つ目標にできる。運命数を引く。運命数＜目標の運命数なら、それを“盗む”。2：武器か兵器に配備して、盗まれるのを防ぐ。（このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない）[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Merc-Sunlet-SWCA-67708.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ティラック・ムンダ出身、頭が切れて気の良い泥棒。金持ちに雇われて、財産を護るための助言を与えることも多い。旅なれており、さまざまな言語に精通している。'' |translation='''Title:''' Merc Sunlet. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Deploy on a non-thief to give thief skill. During your control phase, may target one Item at the same location card. Draw destiny. If destiny is less than the target's destiny, it is stolen. 2: Deploy on a weapon to prevent theft. This Effect is not affected by Alter. '''Lore:''' A clever, good-natured thief from Tirac Munda. The wealthy often hire him to advise on protecting property. He is well traveled and skilled in many languages. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses numbered choose-one. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Merc Sunlet]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

{{Card |title=Ng'ok |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Ngok-SWCA-67788.jpg |lead='''Ng'ok''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_136o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Ng'ok]] (2_136o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_136o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[Ng'ok (PC Errata)]] (2_136) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ヌゴック |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：このターンに相手が4人以上のキャラクターを同じ位置に配備した場合に使用する。それらのキャラクターは全員、このターンの間は戦闘を行えない。2：相手が戦闘に対して“リアクション”を行った直後に使用する。その戦闘をキャンセルする。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Ngok-SWCA-67788.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''デジャリックのホログラムに登場する戦闘獣ヌゴック。ねじけた気性でいつも機嫌が悪い。カミソリのように鋭い鉤爪は伸縮自在。あちこちの星系で番犬がわりに使用されている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Ng'ok. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Use if opponent deployed four or more characters at the same location this turn. Those characters cannot battle this turn. 2: Use just after opponent reacted to a battle. Cancel that battle. '''Lore:''' Ng'ok war beast from a dejarik hologram. Its twisted temper leaves it always in a bad mood. Razor-sharp retractable claws. Used as a watchdog in various star systems. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses numbered choose-one and 位置. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Ng'ok]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-A-New-Hope.png|20px|link=A New Hope Limited]] [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] }}

{{Card |title=Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=A New Hope (Japanese) |set_display=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-ANH-Oo-ta-Goo-ta-Solo-SWCA-67789.jpg |lead='''Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1302_137o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?]] (2_137)

'''Decipher (Japanese Reflections III foil)''' — '''this printing''' |label_versions=Versions |extra_info=FinishFoil |printed_title=いよいよ決着をつける時が来た |printed_game_text=ベイダーとオビ＝ワンが同じ位置カード上にいる時に使う。1フォース消費して決闘を行う。ライト・セーバーを持っているジェダイは戦闘値が＋2される。敗者は除外カードとなり、残りのゲームの間、同じ人物を表すカードは配備できなくなる。 |printed_lore=''ベイダーとオビ＝ワン・ケノービは、デス・スターのハンガー・ベイ327付近にてライトセーバーで最期の決闘を行った。「修行半ばで貴様の下を去ったが、今やすべてを極めた。」'' |translation='''Title:''' The Time Has Finally Come to Settle This. '''Card text:''' Use when Vader and Obi-Wan are at the same site. Use 1 Force to duel. A Jedi with a lightsaber adds 2 to their duel total. The loser is placed out of play, and cards representing the same person cannot deploy for the rest of the game. '''Lore:''' Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi fought their final lightsaber duel near Death Star Hangar Bay 327. “I left you before my training was complete, but now I have mastered everything.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title paraphrases the English title as the time to settle the matter. |notes='''The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[The Circle Is Now Complete|The Circle Is Now Complete]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R41 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R41. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].[[:File:Japanese-The-Circle-Is-Now-Complete-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins. |see_also=* [[Translations of SWCCG#Japanese foils|Japanese foils]] |see_also_heading=See Also |has_refs=1 |set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]]) }}

'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Stunning Leader (V)]] (1240_46) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=気絶に陥るリーダー |printed_game_text=屋内の位置カードで戦闘が宣言された直後に使用する。1フォース消費して、双方の側のすべてのリーダーと能力値＞2のキャラクターを完全にその戦闘から切り離す。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Stunning-Leader-SWCA-100662.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ストームトルーパーは重要な目標を殺さずにスタン（気絶）させる訓練を受けている。これは敵軍を分断し、リーダーを捕まえて尋問するためである。スタンに後遺症はなく、その後の尋問にも支障は出ない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Stunning Leader. '''Card text:''' Use immediately after a battle is declared at an interior location card. Spend 1 Force to completely cut all leaders and characters with ability greater than 2 on both sides out of that battle. '''Lore:''' Stormtroopers are trained to stun (knock unconscious) important targets without killing them. This is to split the enemy and capture leaders for interrogation. Stun has no aftereffects and does not hinder later interrogation. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 位置カード where the English says interior site. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Stunning Leader]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — [[Surprise Assault (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)]] (1371_113o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=急襲 |printed_game_text=1フォース消費して、1つの場所のフォース消耗を、キャンセルできる。相手の持つキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークル、一つごとに、運命数を1枚引く。引いた運命数の合計と、相手の戦闘力の合計を比較する。低いほうが、その差の分だけフォースを失う。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Surprise-Assault-SWCA-100710.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''厳格な軍規の元に行動する帝国軍兵士達は、反乱軍の機転をきかせた待ち伏せ、突然の反撃、妨害行動に、しばしば不意をつかれた。'' |translation='''Title:''' Surprise Assault. '''Card text:''' Spend 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at one location. Draw one destiny for each of the opponent's characters, starships, and vehicles. Compare that destiny total to the opponent's power total. The player with the lower total loses Force equal to the difference. '''Lore:''' Imperial soldiers acting under strict military rules were often caught off guard by Rebel ambushes, sudden counterattacks, and sabotage. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese does not require the opponent's cards to be present. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Surprise Assault]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. '''Decipher Errata''' — [[Tauntaun (Errata)]] (3_70) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=トーントーン |printed_game_text=乗客を1名乗せられる。ホス上にのみ配備できるが、それ以降はどこにでも移動させてもよい。能力値＝1/4。リアクションとして戦闘から移動して逃げることができる。犠牲にする（ロストさせる）ことによって、乗客をそのターンの間「凍死」の影響を受けないようにすることができる。[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Tauntaun-SWCA-100693.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ホスで最初に発見された土着生物。氷原を群れをなして移動する。気が短くて臆病。体表は猛烈な獣の臭いを放つ。反乱軍のパトロール用に飼いならされている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Tauntaun. '''Card text:''' May carry 1 passenger. May deploy only on Hoth, but may move anywhere after that. Ability equals 1/4. May move and flee from a battle as a reaction. You may sacrifice (lose) it to make the passenger immune to "freezing death" this turn. '''Lore:''' The first native creature found on Hoth. They travel the ice fields in herds. Short-tempered and timid. Their bodies give off a fierce animal smell. They have been tamed for Rebel patrols. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes a fierce animal smell and taming for patrols. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Tauntaun]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_53o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=貴様の失策につきあうのもこれが最後だ |printed_game_text=場にベイダーが出ている場合に、相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使用する。戦闘に参加している運命数＜6の相手のリーダーを目標とする。相手が戦闘に勝利しなかったなら、目標は没収値＝0となり、即座にロストする。オゼルであれば除外カードとなる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-You-Have-Failed-Me-For-The-Last-Time-PSA-85187828.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「ベイダー卿。艦隊は光速を脱し、これより……うわっ……うぐ……ぐえっ」'' |translation='''Title:''' You Have Failed Me For The Last Time. '''Card text:''' If Vader is on table, play just after the opponent declares a battle. Target an opponent's leader in that battle with destiny less than 6. If the opponent did not win, the target's forfeit becomes 0 and it is immediately lost. If it is Ozzel, it becomes an excluded card. '''Lore:''' Lord Vader. The fleet has left lightspeed, and from now... whoa... ugh... gueh. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is a translated movie line, not a literal English title. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[You Have Failed Me For The Last Time]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Virtual Modern''' — [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System (V)]] (225_59) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=おまえはダゴバ星系に行くのだ |printed_game_text=自分の支配フェイズに２フォース消費して[Hoth]がついた自分の任意の能力値＞1のキャラクターを1人、自分の人員がいる[Dagobah]がついたロケーションに移動させる。ダゴバの位置に移動させるなら、移動にはフォースを消費せず、そこに人員がいる必要もない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-You-Will-Go-To-The-Dagobah-System-PSA-93899917.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「そこでお前はヨーダから学ぶ。私の師たるジェダイ・マスターだ」'' |translation='''Title:''' You Will Go To The Dagobah System. If moving to a Dagobah location, the move costs no Force and does not need presence. '''Lore:''' There you will learn from Yoda. He is the Jedi Master who taught me. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Paid move costs 2 Force; English costs 1 Force. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. {{Card |title=Zev Senesca |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Zev-Senesca-PSA-85187817.jpg |lead='''Zev Senesca''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_27o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=2 |power=2 |ability=2 |deploy=2 |forfeit=4 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Zev Senesca]] (3_027o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_27o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Zev Senesca (Errata)]] (3_027) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ゼヴ・セネスカ |printed_game_text=操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２を加える。ローグ２を操縦するなら回避値に３を加え、戦闘運命数を引けない場合にも１枚引ける。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Zev-Senesca-PSA-85187817.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ベスティーン星系に近いケスティック・ステーションの出身。あらゆる機種を乗りこなす温和なパイロット。ホスの氷原でルークとハンを発見した。ホスの戦いではローグ2を操縦。'' |translation='''Title:''' Zev Senesca. '''Card text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Rogue 2, also add 3 to maneuver, and may draw one battle destiny even if not able to otherwise. '''Lore:''' Born at Kestic Station near the Bestine system. A mild-mannered pilot who can handle every craft. He found Luke and Han on Hoth's ice plains. He piloted Rogue 2 at the Battle of Hoth. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore calls him 温和な (mild-mannered); English says daring. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Zev Senesca]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Walker Barrage |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Walker-Barrage-PSA-88099884.jpg |lead='''Walker Barrage''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_140o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Walker Barrage]] (3_140o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_140o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Walker Barrage (Errata)]] (3_140) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ウォーカーの猛攻 |printed_game_text=パイロットが搭乗している自分のＡＴ－ＡＴが位置にいるなら、同じ位置か屋外の隣接位置にある固定兵器を目標とする。運命数を引く。運命数＋1＞没収値なら目標はロストする。さらに運命数＋1＞6なら目標と同じ位置にいる相手のキャラクターも1名ロストする（複数いるなら無作為に選ぶ）。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Walker-Barrage-PSA-88099884.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ＡＴ－ＡＴに満載された兵員が実際に外に出て敵と交戦する前に、ウォーカーは反乱分子の防御装置を破壊しておかなければならない。'' |translation='''Title:''' Walker Barrage. '''Card text:''' If you have a piloted AT-AT at a location, target an artillery weapon at the same location or an adjacent exterior location. Draw destiny. The target is lost if destiny +1 exceeds forfeit. One opponent's character at the target's location is also lost if destiny +1 exceeds 6, chosen at random if more than one is there. Japanese uses 位置 for site and 固定兵器 for artillery weapon. Lore says 反乱分子 rather than Rebel traitors. Destiny +1 thresholds match the English face. '''Lore:''' Before the troops packed into an AT-AT actually go outside and fight the enemy, the walker must destroy the Rebel elements' defenses. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses 位置 for site and 固定兵器 for artillery weapon. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Walker Barrage]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=Wall Of Fire |side=Dark |type=Interrupt |type_display=[[Interrupt]] |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-Wall-Of-Fire-PSA-88099885.jpg |lead='''Wall Of Fire''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_141o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=5 |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Wall Of Fire]] (3_141o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_141o)
'''Decipher Errata''' — [[Wall Of Fire (Errata)]] (3_141) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=炎の壁 |printed_game_text=パイロットが搭乗している自分のＡＴ－ＡＴが位置にいるなら、同じ位置か隣接する屋外位置にいる兵員／トルーパーを好きなだけ目標として選ぶ。運命数を引く。運命数＞目標とした兵員／トルーパーの人数なら、それらは全員即座にロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Wall-Of-Fire-PSA-88099885.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''ウォーカーにかかれば歩兵部隊など数秒でまるごと灰と化してしまう。反乱軍の兵員たちはこの苛烈な弾幕を“炎の壁”として恐れている。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wall Of Fire. '''Card text:''' If you have a piloted AT-AT at a location, target as many troopers as you want at the same location or an adjacent exterior location. Draw destiny. If destiny is greater than the number of troopers targeted, they are all immediately lost. Title is 炎の壁. Game text targets 兵員／トルーパー rather than troopers only, and uses 位置 for site. '''Lore:''' If a walker hits them, infantry units and the like are turned to ash in seconds. Rebel troops fear this fierce barrage as the "wall of fire." '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is 炎の壁. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wall Of Fire]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_93o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Wampa (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)]] (1104_50)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Wampa (V)]] (1220_21) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=ワンパ |printed_game_text=＊凶暴性＝3＋運命数。生息地：ホスの位置。「ワンパの雪洞」か未踏査のマーカー位置にのみ配備する。負けたキャラクターは食べられるか、あるいは「ワンパの雪洞」に移される（犠牲者の相手プレイヤーが選択する）。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Wampa-PSA-92654369.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''雪に被われたツンドラを徘徊する狡猾な肉食獣。ワンパはしばしば獲物を自分の巣に持ち帰って保存する。屍肉よりも生きたままの獲物を好んでむさぼり食うのだ。'' |translation='''Title:''' Wampa. '''Card text:''' * Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: Hoth locations. Deploy only to Wampa Cave or an unexplored marker location. A defeated character is eaten or moved to Wampa Cave. The victim's opponent chooses. Printed subtype is 寒冷地生物, not Snow. Habitat uses 位置. Deploy restriction uses 未踏査 rather than unoccupied. Vicious Howl is printed 血も凍る叫び声 3. Lore prints 被われた. '''Lore:''' A cunning carnivore that prowls snow-covered tundra. Wampas often drag prey to their dens for storage. They prefer to devour living prey rather than carrion. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 寒冷地生物, not Snow. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Wampa]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}

{{Card |title=WED-1016 'Techie' Droid |side=Light |type=Character |type_display=[[Character]] ([[Droid]]) |set=Hoth (Japanese) |set_display=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |language=ja |navigation=[[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]] |image=Japanese-Hoth-WED-1016-Techie-Droid-PSA-89232349.jpg |lead='''WED-1016 'Techie' Droid''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]]. |gemp_id=1303_24o |label_gemp_id=Printing ID |destiny=3 |power=0 |deploy=2 |forfeit=3 |uniqueness=Unique |publisher=[[Decipher]] |era=[[Decipher era]] |versions='''Decipher''' — [[WED-1016 'Techie' Droid]] (3_24o)

'''Card text:''' If at an exterior planet location or a docking bay, once per turn you may lose 1 Force. Move one starship or vehicle hit by a weapon at the same or adjacent location to the Used Pile instead of the Lost Pile. '''Lore:''' A Cybot Galactica starship-maintenance droid. It can repair more than 5,000 kinds of equipment. Rebel salvage teams use it. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title adds the gloss （技術屋） for Techie. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[WED-1016 'Techie' Droid]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. '''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_52o) |label_versions=Versions |printed_title=誰がみすぼらしいって？ |printed_game_text=どちらかを選ぶ。1：「みすぼらしいナーフ飼い」、「ウーキーとキスする方がましだわ」、「毛むくじゃら、おかんむり」、「こんなはずじゃあ…」、「死の烙印」、「悲しみの雄叫び」、「タキール」、「ケット・マリス」のいずれかをキャンセルする。2：このターンの終わりまでレネックの戦闘力を2倍にする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Whos-Scruffy-Looking-PSA-85187824.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]]. |printed_lore=''「照れてるのさ。図星をつかれて怒ったんだ。だろ？」'' |translation='''Title:''' Who's Scruffy-Looking?. '''Card text:''' Choose one. 1: Cancel Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder, I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee, Furry Fury, This Is Just Wrong, Death Mark, Mournful Roar, Takeel, or Ket Maliss. 2: Double Rennek's power until this turn ends. '''Lore:''' "She's just embarrassed. I hit the mark, so she got angry. Right?" '''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese names the eight cancel targets, including 死の烙印 and 悲しみの雄叫び. |notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Who's Scruffy-Looking?]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. |has_refs=1 |set_icon=[[File:Icon-set-Hoth.png|20px|link=Hoth Limited]] [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]] }}
